citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
"Penny Cents", a red, female poodle (ID: 956000012023299) has crusted material with a mucous discharge on the top of
the left eyelid. The eye is covered with a grey membrane type of tissue. This eye squints when exposed to sunlight. The
right eye has a pencil eraser size area across the pupil that is an opulent gray shade, with the surface appearing
thickened and raised and squints slightly when exposed to sunlight.. The licensee had not noticed the eye issues nor
sought veterinary care. Eye issues may be painful and cause problems with sight. Any sick or injured animal must be
examined by a licensed veterinarian and health records must be maintained. This dog must be examined by a
veterinarian within the next 24 hours and treatment administered as appropriate.
* To be corrected: 8/4/26 (within 24 hrs)
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with licensee.
